entries.name: Vitality
entries.notes: SHIPPED — id, kindId and params kept verbatim per atom-family-library.md §3.1 (maxHp Flat) and naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies (g.life existingFamilies). No `amount` param — DERIVED from powerBand and this channel's own share (bands.v1.json primaryChannel worked example, share=3%). `roles` is the life column of ssot-affixes.md §4.3's role x group matrix, translated from the stale 12-role table to core.v1.json's 15 ids: head-protective->head-guard, sense-utility->sense, core-protective->core-guard, mantle-utility->mantle, footing stays, girdle-resource->girdle, jewel-major stays, jewel-minor->jewel-minor-a and jewel-minor-b, armament-secondary stays. manipulator-offense and armament-primary carry weight 0 for life and are correctly absent; the commander-only `standard` row carries weight 2 but is not one of the 15 body roles. Every entry in this file shares this identical roles list, per §4.3's one-row-per-group-per-role shape. `nameWords.prefix` reproduces ssot-affixes.md §4.12's shipped Band A/B/C word table for this family verbatim (Hale/Robust/Vital).

entries.name: Fortitude
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id and params kept verbatim (atom-family-library.md §3.1: maxHp Increased). `powerBand: "low"` against `vitality`'s `medium` is the same relative-pull judgement the exemplar makes between a Flat family and its Increased sibling (elemental-power vs elpw-amplify) — Increased compounds against every Flat source already on the actor, so it earns a smaller per-tier pull. `nameWords.prefix` reproduces the shipped Band A/B/C words verbatim (Sound/Sturdy/Enduring).

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id and params kept verbatim (atom-family-library.md §3.1: maxHp More, flagged "rare tier band only"). `powerBand: "high"` reflects that flag — the multiplicative lever is the strongest of the three maxHp ops, which is exactly why the family library restricts it to the rare tier window rather than the ordinary five-tier spread. `nameWords.prefix` carries only the Band C word: ssot-affixes.md §4.12's sample table shows Band A and Band B as an explicit em-dash for `bulwark`, because a min-tier-4 family never rolls at t1-t3 (Band A) or t3 (Band B) at all. A one-word pool is correct here, not an omission.

entries.name: Mending
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id and params kept verbatim (atom-family-library.md §3.1: hp Flat, "current-HP top-up on grant" — a one-time instant heal at bind, distinct from `maxHp` which is a continuously composed cap). `powerBand: "low"` because a one-time top-up is a smaller lifetime value than a persistent maxHp bump at the same nominal size. Band C word `Restorative` is shipped verbatim from ssot-affixes.md §4.12's plant-override table, which also ships the plant-frame override `Verdant` (not encoded here — `word_plant` is a runtime naming-table column this seed file does not carry, per the affix-family entry shape). Bands A and B (`Balming`, `Resinous`) are minted here on the same healing-salve/tree-resin register, since no shipped word exists for them.

entries.name: Vital Graft
entries.notes: NEW family minted on this group's reserved `life` stem (naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies), word `graft` — a grafted patch of tissue, mechanical rather than flavour. Fills the one maxHp/hp x op combination the four shipped families leave open on the `hp` channel: `mending` (shipped) is `hp` Flat, `vitality`/`fortitude`/`bulwark` (shipped) already cover all three ops on `maxHp`, so this is `hp` Increased — a percentage top-up on grant scaled off the actor's own current HP at that instant, the same one-time-at-bind semantics `mending`'s note documents, never a continuously recomposed multiplier. `powerBand: "trivial"` keeps it the smallest pull in the group, since a percentage of current HP is a weaker and more variable promise than `mending`'s flat number at low levels.

entries.name: Vital Surge
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `life`, word `surge`. Closes the `hp` x op matrix started by `mending` (Flat) and `atom.life-graft` (Increased): this is `hp` More, the multiplicative on-grant heal — the strongest of the three levers on the same trigger-free channel, the way `bulwark` (More) sits above `vitality`/`fortitude` on `maxHp`. `powerBand: "medium"` keeps it below `bulwark`'s `high`, since a one-time current-HP heal is a smaller lifetime value than a persistent maxHp multiplier at the same relative pull, mirroring the `mending`-vs-`vitality` judgement already made above.
